workerExecutionStatus: not_run_by_worker: no numerical checks, training, tests, build, lint, formatter or submission
resultPolicy: This file specifies inputs and assertions, not measured results. Main runs an independent temporary implementation and stores actual evidence in p8-shared. No full solution program is published.

mechanismChecks.operations: Apply [^A-Za-z]+ -> one space, strip/lower per line; direct character flatten without separator. Separate toy vocabulary: reserve <unk>=0, frequency descending then lexical ascending ties.
assertions: cleanedLines == ['alpha beta','gamma']
flattened == 'alpha betagamma'
transform('z') == 0
vocabulary unchanged after validation transform
mechanismChecks.scope: Synthetic local contract only; not a claim about real corpus counts.

assertions: Y[:, :-1] == X[:, 1:] within each batch
previousY[:, -1] == nextX[:, 0] for the same row
all X/Y original indices belong to one split
randomized independent windows must reset state for every batch
negativeCases: split after window creation leaks target indices
row permutation with unpermuted carried state is invalid
detach of a random-window old state does not repair its wrong numerical history

inputs.weights: explicit fixed finite nonzero small matrices shared by both paths

mechanismChecks.mapping: Scratch right-multiplication matrices transpose into API weights; API b_ih + b_hh equals scratch b_h. Same initial state and output projection. Preserve time-major ordering.
assertions: timeMajorOneHot.shape == (3,2,4)
logits.shape == (6,4)
flattened target equals Y.T.reshape(-1)
max absolute error of all logits and final hidden state < 1e-9
mapped gradients for a shared scalar objective agree with atol=1e-9 and rtol=1e-7
mechanismChecks.caveat: Do not assert one-step optimizer equivalence with both API biases trainable versus one scratch bias: their summed update differs unless parameterization/freeze policy is aligned. This is ordinary RNN equivalence, not a blanket GRU formula equivalence.

assertions: all trainable parameter gradients contribute to one global norm
postNorm <= 1 + 1e-6
postGradients close to expected at atol=1e-6
gradient vector [0.3,0.4] remains unchanged
nonfinite gradient is an explicit failure, not hidden by clipping
mechanismChecks.scope: Main may use an equivalent higher-dimensional vector; normal real training need not trigger scaling. Record whether it did.

assertions: CE == sum(valid token NLL)/count(valid tokens)
PPL == exp(CE)
unequal-token case is neither mean([2,8]) nor exp(mean(batch means))
padding excluded only by explicit mask; <unk> is not padding
zero valid targets must not produce a finite reported score
detach preserves h1 value and removes its historical autograd edge
resetting h1 to zero changes forward value and is not detach
in actual LSTM both h and c detached values equal originals
detached h and c have no old grad_fn
new-window parameters still receive finite nonzero gradients where fixture establishes a path
mechanismChecks.caveat: No retain_graph workaround; optimizer.zero_grad does not detach states.

assertions: unprojected LSTM c.shape == h.shape
output projection width equals directions*H
batch_first=True changes only input/output batch-time ordering, not hidden-state layout
bidirectional final output at last time is not the pair of final directional states

mechanismChecks.inputs: Two sequences with identical prefix and a differing future token; same initial states, deterministic nonzero weights, eval mode, no dropout.
assertions: unidirectional outputs before the changed token are equal within 1e-9 in float64 fixture
construct a nonzero reverse dependency so bidirectional earlier output differs by more than 1e-6
identify y_t=x_(t+1) inside future input
do not interpret bidirectional next-token CE as causal language-model perplexity
mechanismChecks.caveat: All-zero weights can mask future dependence; use a deliberate nondegenerate counterexample, not an unconditional random test.

mechanismChecks.inputs: One causal trained or fixed model; prefix abc, also prefix length1 and requested new-token count0; one fixed validation stream and initial state.
assertions: consume a and b only to warm state, then consume c exactly once to obtain logits for first new token
autoregressive loop feeds model output, not held-out answers
independent prefix generation resets state and does not update weights
new-token count tracked separately from rendered string length when <unk> occurs
same fixed stream, token set and carried state yield equal eval CE under different processing chunk lengths within dtype-appropriate tolerance
mechanismChecks.caveat: Changing batch size can change row-stream boundaries and context; no general batch-size-invariance assertion.

realCorpusContract.split: Clean each line, remove empty cleaned lines; n remaining lines; train[0,floor(.8n)), val[floor(.8n),floor(.9n)), test[floor(.9n),n). Preserve original-line provenance. Independently flatten each segment without interline separator.
realCorpusContract.vocabularyFit: Complete training segment only, before selecting small prefixes; not validation/test and not falsely described as fit on only8192 tokens.

smallRunCandidateTokens.test: sealed, not evaluated in phase small run

realCorpusContract.trainingPolicy: Sequential rows retain identity, epoch starts reset state, each following training batch detaches carried state (both h/c for LSTM). Record final shorter window or dropped tails. Effective tokens, not candidate count, determine CE denominator.
realCorpusContract.evaluationPolicy: Fixed separate validation stream, eval/no_grad, reset at split start, carry within stream; fixed-mode initial/final train and validation rescoring separately from optimization-time sums. No parameter updates. Save lossSum and validTokenCount.
requiredEvidence: actual raw acquisition hash and legal-use boundary
raw/clean line boundaries and split hashes
actual ordered vocab and fit range
seed, runtime, hardware, threads, parameter count
actual epochs, steps, window lengths and tokens
finite gradients and real parameter update
preclip/postclip norm and whether actual scaling occurred
initial/final comparable scoring and per-epoch weighted metrics
actual checkpoint/prefix/decoding config/new-token IDs/raw generated output
realCorpusContract.qualityPolicy: No fabricated text, minimum PPL, monotone per-step decline, winner claim or fluency pass. Short repetitive output remains in evidence.
realCorpusContract.studentScopeBoundary: Main's small API three-model run plus mechanism checks does not by itself complete all student tasks. Student task2 also calls for a real, possibly very short, scratch-RNN training/generation record; local API equivalence is not that record.

hardwareBoundary: Only report actual measured CPU/GPU/device and timing. No throughput or GPU extrapolation from shapes or API documentation.
publicationBoundary: No original novel full text, raw dataset artifact, checkpoint binary, full training/solution script, cookies or tokens in content. Keep only small provenance txt/json and pedagogical instructions.
